# One Pager: <Title>

- **Author:** <name>
- **Approvers:** <names>
- **Status:** Draft | In review | Accepted | Rejected | Implemented
- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Decision deadline:** YYYY-MM-DD

A short, stand-alone RFC for a small initiative. If it grows past one page, write an RFC. See [`../reference/proposals.md`](../reference/proposals.md).

## Problem

What is broken or missing, for whom, and how we know. Include evidence: data, incidents, user reports.

## Proposal

The rough shape of the solution, in a few paragraphs or a sketch.

## Alternatives

Other approaches and why this one wins.

## Open Questions

What you want reviewers to weigh in on.
